from common import *
import pickle,functools,gc

def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    variant=sys.argv[1];year=int(sys.argv[2]);assert variant in VARIANTS and year in range(2020,2027)
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd,qlib
    from qlib.data.dataset.handler import DataHandlerLP
    from qlib.data.dataset import processor
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.config_loader import load_config
    from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
    assert Path(qlib.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=2)
    processor.datetime_groupby_apply=functools.partial(processor.datetime_groupby_apply,n_jobs=1)
    start=max(f'{year}-01-01','2020-08-03');end=min(f'{year}-12-31','2026-07-31')
    cached=TMP/f'formal-inference-{year}.pkl';receipt=BASE/'docs'/f'inference-input-{year}.json'
    if cached.exists():
        doc=read(receipt);check(doc['cache']);frame=pd.read_pickle(cached)
        assert frame_signature(frame)==doc['features']
    else:
        cfg=load_config(str(BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml'));cfg['segments']['test']=[start,end];cfg['data']['handler']['learn_processors']=[]
        ds=ev._build_dataset(cfg,'all');frame=ds.prepare('test',col_set='feature',data_key=DataHandlerLP.DK_I)
        assert frame.shape[1]==164 and frame.index.is_unique
        del ds;gc.collect()
        frame.to_pickle(cached)
        ref=read(PRIOR/'docs/sources-h20.json')['components'][0];check(ref['model'])
        with (ROOT/ref['model']['path']).open('rb') as f:m=pickle.load(f)
        actual=pd.Series(m.model.predict(frame.to_numpy(),num_threads=8),index=frame.index)
        reference=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/'backtest/result/20261105_horizon_p50/h20/horizonp50_20261105_h20_s42_pred.pkl').iloc[:,0]
        reference=reference.loc[(reference.index.get_level_values('datetime')>=pd.Timestamp(start))&(reference.index.get_level_values('datetime')<=pd.Timestamp(end))]
        assert actual.index.equals(reference.index)
        assert np.array_equal(actual.to_numpy(),reference.to_numpy(),equal_nan=True),'frozen control formal inference drift'
        doc={'year':year,'segment':[start,end],'features':frame_signature(frame),'cache':fingerprint(cached),'formal_DK_I':True,'learn_chain_omitted':True,'control_prediction_exact':True,'control_model':ref['model'],'cache_ownership':'task temporary; delete after all candidates evaluated'};write(receipt,doc)
        del m,reference,actual;gc.collect()
    jobs=[j for j in read(PROGRESS)['jobs'] if j['variant']==variant]
    assert jobs and all(j['status']=='succeeded' for j in jobs)
    outputs=[]
    for j in jobs:
        out=TMP/f'infer-{j["job_id"]}-{year}.pkl'
        assert not out.exists(),'inference output already exists; verify prior receipt before resume'
        record=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{j["job_id"]}.json');check(record['model'])
        with (ROOT/record['model']['path']).open('rb') as f:model=pickle.load(f)
        score=pd.Series(model.model.predict(frame.to_numpy(),num_threads=8),index=frame.index,name='score')
        assert np.isfinite(score.to_numpy()).all();score.to_pickle(out)
        outputs.append({'job_id':j['job_id'],'seed':j['seed'],'treatment':j['treatment'],'model':record['model'],'prediction_part':fingerprint(out)});del model,score
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{variant}-{year}.json',{'input':fingerprint(receipt),'predictions':outputs})
    print(variant,year,'predictions',len(outputs),'rows',len(frame),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
